scope: Historical generation record. Retired source GLBs and local reference/task files are intentionally excluded from the production repository; runtime paths are defined in src/assetManifest.js.
visual_rule: Visible prop, character and building models are generated by Meshy from approved isolated references. Structural walls, floors, roads and curbs use deterministic rectilinear geometry so Image-to-3D warping can never break architecture.

generation.workflow: approved 2D reference -> Meshy Image-to-3D -> GLB -> in-game validation
generation.environment_strategy: isolated props for the warehouse; each city building is reconstructed as one complete closed Meshy model from four consistent orthographic views

v4_outputs.navigation: warehouse, street, shop interior and house interior are separate bounded locations connected only by explicit yes/no door confirmations

v5_outputs.branding_policy: Robinhood mark appears on the shop only; residential houses remain unbranded

v6_outputs.seed_pack_policy: The Robinhood mark is baked into the Meshy-generated model texture; no runtime logo plane, sticker or CanvasTexture is attached to the package
v6_outputs.city_adjustment: The shop is lowered into the curb and both city models use full-footprint collision volumes

v7_outputs.correction: Regenerated through Meshy from a clean flat-printed logo reference to eliminate the central texture and geometry blemish without runtime decals

v8_outputs.integration: The Meshy model is spatially split while preserving its baked texture: frame and motor remain static, the shutter leaf slides upward automatically near the functional warehouse entrance/exit, and the V3 procedural door is removed.

v9_outputs.integration: Active V9 street layer: lamps, vegetation, moving delivery van, loading props, street furniture and one approved idle neighbor. The black street cat, detailed young walker, sliding cat patrol and fused three-building block were removed after visual review.

v10_outputs.integration: Two individually generated low-detail houses replace the rejected fused three-building block. Each house remains independently positionable and replaceable.

v33_outputs.integration: A visually approved seated cream low-poly cat with blue eyes and tear markings replaces the retired black V9 sidewalk cat.
